title: Wren and the Choir
author: Marguerite Yarrow
blurb: Coral Underhill, a thief who steals memories, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
